LanguageData.LP_TT_TitanBody.label: titan body
LanguageData.LP_TT_TitanBody.description: Passive: body size ×(1 + 2.5% × fighter level) (×1.5 at level 20; after fighter reaches 20, adventurer legend levels keep counting, up to ×2.0), affecting the chance to be hit in melee, food intake, pack load and other vanilla effects; graphics (body, head, clothes, weapons) scale by √body size. Part health gets another +3% × fighter level on top of class level growth (+60% at level 20). Titan Fighter, fighter level 3.
LanguageData.LP_TT_MightyGrip.label: mighty grip
LanguageData.LP_TT_MightyGrip.description: Passive: carrying capacity +2% × fighter level. Melee hits against enemies smaller than you deal ×1.15 damage and have a 25% chance to knock them back 1 cell. Titan Fighter, fighter level 3.
LanguageData.LP_TT_Stomp.label: earthshaking stomp
LanguageData.LP_TT_Stomp.description: A heavy stomp: enemies within radius 2.9 take 10 + Strength modifier × 3 blunt damage; enemies smaller than you are also knocked down (stunned 2 seconds), with success 60% + size difference × 30%, up to 95%. Spares allies. Grit 2, cooldown 15 seconds. Titan Fighter, fighter level 3.
LanguageData.LP_TT_Immovable.label: immovable as a mountain
LanguageData.LP_TT_Immovable.description: Passive: pain shock threshold +10%, can't be knocked back, pushed or tripped, and stun durations are halved. Titan Fighter, fighter level 7.
LanguageData.LP_TT_Titanize.label: titanic form
LanguageData.LP_TT_Titanize.description: Become a titan for 60 seconds: body size another ×1.25, part health ×1.25, melee damage ×1.25, move speed ×0.9. Exhausted afterwards: rest -20%. Grit 3, once per day. Titan Fighter, fighter level 11.
LanguageData.LP_TT_AncientTitan.label: ancient titan
LanguageData.LP_TT_AncientTitan.description: Passive: titanic form lasts 120 seconds and no longer leaves you exhausted; during titanic form each melee hit has a 20% chance to trigger a small stomp (radius 1.9, half damage, no grit cost). Titan Fighter, fighter level 15.
